newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: GM vehicle sales in Colombia down in 1996.
newsitem.headline: GM vehicle sales in Colombia down in 1996.

text.p: Sales of General Motors vehicles fell 7.4 percent in Colombia in 1996 compared to 1995, assembler General Motors-Colmotores said on Tuesday.

The assembler sold 38,577 vehicles -- 22,104 cars and 16,473 commercial vehicles -- last year against 41,660 in 1995. More than 29,000 of those were assembled in Colombia and the remainder were imported, General Motors-Colmotores said.
In December alone, the assembler sold 3,050 vehicles, 2,398 of which were assembled in the country.
